name: "Agricultural Income Tax Holiday" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme"
benefit: **Benefit Period:** 3 years of Agricultural Income Tax holiday. **Applicable Financial Years:** 2022-23 to 2024-25. **Condition:** Returns must be filed within the due date; if not filed on the due date, interest and penalty will be applicable.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a tea plantation across all sizes. - The applicant must be a tea manufacturing unit manufacturing Crush, Tear, Curl Tea, Orthodox Tea, or Speciality tea including Green tea, Oolong Tea, White tea, Yellow tea and Purple tea. - The applicant must be located entirely in Assam. - The applicant must not have any part of the plantation or manufacturing facility located outside the State of Assam.
